challenge.better_approach: Considered: make the bus dispose of any bounce whose names start with testing-. But b3386f431ae3 settled that the mark rides in the body, not the name. Or have BaseShim._fire mark its posts, but live probes must not be marked. Marking in the proof's own wrapper is the smallest change.
challenge.hidden_assumption: That a marked body rides through to the bounce. b3386f431ae3 (PROVED) made a marked bounce inherit the mark and get disposed of. Measured here: the body read back from the live bus carries the mark.
challenge.prior_art: test_console_pane.py:36 and test_chat_pane.py:35 already put testing_mark.FIELD on every body. This copies that pattern.
challenge.real_collision: none: ad7caca4d54c asked for this, and b3386f431ae3's disposal is what it relies on.

answers.falsifier: Every letter the end-to-end tooth posts carries a testing mark, read back from the live bus. The tooth still passes. A run of the tooth raises no new mail-testing-*-has-no-receiver trouble.
answers.from_idea: none, because this was measured, not imagined: 8 live troubles mail-testing-ad7caca4d54c-recipient-*-has-no-receiver in ~/.cairn/logs/cairn/0/troubletickets/ (bin/cairn trouble live --json, 2026-11-16), raised by test_probe_carry.py's live-bus tooth
answers.how: In cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_probe_carry.py, the _TestingBus wrapper stamps testing_mark.mark('ad7caca4d54c') on every body it posts, the way the console and chat pane proofs already mark theirs. A red-first proof records every post the tooth makes, and checks each body read back from the live bus carries the mark.
answers.traces_to: Law 7: the trouble lane is a record of truth, and test debris there crowds out real errors. ad7caca4d54c's intention says every name AND body is marked as testing, and this tooth marked only the names.
answers.what: The probe-carry proof's live-bus poke carries the testing mark, so when no one can take its bounce the bus throws it away instead of raising a live trouble.

bullets.text: base's probe-carry proof marked the names but not the body, so its bounces raised 8 live troubles. The body is now marked.
